args.evidence_for: r-edge FORWARD rule 1 REJECTs all tcp/445 to 10.10.3.10, staff tcp/445 fails while other staff flows pass.
args.hypothesis: r-edge firewall REJECT rule for tcp/445 to fileserver blocks staff share access.
